key_insight: DP-Learner predicts electronic-structure Hamiltonians directly as symmetry-preserving operator blocks, avoiding fragmentation into irreducible spherical-tensor components.
engineering_relevance: Direct-product representations align learned features with orbital and spin couplings, potentially reducing transformations and improving computational efficiency.
method: Pass messages over Hamiltonian-like matrices or tensors in a direct-product-space Transformer.
Use Lie-generator directional embeddings and equivariant products and contractions without explicit Clebsch–Gordan decomposition.
Control gating, attention, directional propagation, and environment interactions with invariant scalar routing.
evidence_signal: The authors introduce MP-HAM-110K with over 110,000 structures spanning 68 elements and report improved accuracy and inference efficiency on it and Materials-HAM-SOC, without numerical results in the abstract.
watch_item: Practical speedups and memory demands should be checked across orbital-basis sizes and hardware configurations.
paper_title: Equivariant Deep Learning in Direct-Product Space for Electronic-Structure Hamiltonian Prediction
